title: I'm developing a factory automation game for Steam with the help of AI
author: OkabeMasataka
selftext:
I'm a solo developer working on **CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations**, a factory automation game about automating care for babies from birth to one year old.

I use AI quite a lot during development, but rather than simply using generated content as-is, I mostly use it as a tool to speed up prototyping and iteration.

For example, for the babies, I created a base 3D model without eyes, a mouth, or hair, then made those as separate parts so I can create different appearances and facial expressions.

For the care machines, I first create concept images with AI, then turn those ideas into 3D assets using Claude Code and Blender. At first, I designed each machine individually, but when I put them together, the factory lacked visual consistency. So I generated concept images of the factory as a whole, established a shared design language from those images, and then applied it back to each individual machine. I've redesigned the machines two or three times so far.

I've also used AI for research and exploration around individual differences in babies and ways of interacting with them, then translated those ideas into game systems where players design production lines around growth stages and individual traits.

The video itself is not AI-generated — it's actual gameplay footage.

Steam:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5187610/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5187610/)

If the concept sounds interesting, I'd really appreciate a wishlist on Steam.
